level1.title: Zacchaeus Climbs a Tree
level1.story: Zacchaeus was a short man. He climbed a tree to see Jesus. Jesus said, "Zacchaeus, come down! I will stay at your house today."
level1.keyLine: Jesus wants to be with me.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Why did Zacchaeus climb a tree?
level1.prayer: Jesus, come into my heart. Amen.

level2.title: Today Salvation Has Come
level2.story: Jesus was passing through Jericho, and a rich chief tax collector named Zacchaeus wanted to see Him. He was short, so he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore tree. When Jesus came, He looked up and said, "Zacheus, make haste and come down; for this day I must abide in thy house." People grumbled, but Zacchaeus said, "Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor." Jesus said, "This day is salvation come to this house... For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost."
level2.keyLine: The Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How did meeting Jesus change Zacchaeus?
What can you make right this week?
actions: Repair something I broke or said
level2.prayer: Jesus, seek me and save me. Amen.
